mnemonic.meaning: The degree (度) of damp (湿). The humidity level.
mnemonic.reading: SHE, TSU, DOUGH (しつど): she can't make dough at this humidity.

examples.ja: 今日は湿度が八十パーセントだ。
examples.en: The humidity is eighty percent today.

items.note: A measured value. 湿気 (Level 20) is the moisture you feel.

mnemonic.meaning: Mutually (相) continue (続) the family line. Inheritance.
mnemonic.reading: SO, ZOKU (そうぞく): "So, Zoku inherits everything?"

examples.ja: 父の財産を相続した。
examples.en: I inherited my father's property.

items.note: Legal. 遺産相続 = inheriting an estate. 継ぐ (WaniKani) = to take over.

mnemonic.meaning: The logic (理) of life (生). Physiology, menstruation.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, REE (せいり): "Say, Ree, how's your physiology class?" Same sound as 整理 (tidying).

examples.ja: 生理現象だから仕方がない。
examples.en: It's a bodily function, so it can't be helped.

items.note: Commonly means menstruation: 生理痛 (period pain). 生理学 = physiology.

mnemonic.meaning: 卸 is wholesale: to sell wholesale.
mnemonic.reading: OH, ROSS (おろす): Ross sells his couches wholesale.

examples.ja: この会社は野菜を店に卸している。
examples.en: This company sells vegetables wholesale to shops.

items.note: 卸売り = wholesale. Also grating: 大根をおろす (often 下ろす / おろす).

mnemonic.meaning: 老 is old: old age.
mnemonic.reading: OY (おい)! the old man shouts. Aging.

examples.ja: 最近、老いを感じる。
examples.en: I've been feeling my age lately.

items.note: Literary. 年をとる is everyday for aging. 老人 = elderly person.

mnemonic.meaning: Buckwheat (蕎) and wheat (麦). Soba noodles.
mnemonic.reading: SOBA (そば): soba noodles. Same sound as 側 (beside).

examples.ja: 昼ご飯に蕎麦を食べた。
examples.en: I had soba for lunch.

items.note: Usually そば. 年越しそば is eaten on New Year's Eve.

mnemonic.meaning: 煮 has 灬 (fire): something cooks over fire. To be boiled.
mnemonic.reading: KNEE, AIR, RUE (にえる): the stew is cooked; the steam hits your knee.

examples.ja: 野菜がよく煮えた。
examples.en: The vegetables are cooked through.

items.note: Intransitive partner of 煮る (Level 18). 煮え切らない = indecisive.

mnemonic.meaning: 便 is mail: news by mail. A letter.
mnemonic.reading: TIE, OH, REE (たより): a letter tied with a ribbon. News!

examples.ja: 故郷の母から便りが届いた。
examples.en: A letter came from my mother back home.

items.note: Literary. 便りがないのは良い便り = no news is good news.

mnemonic.meaning: A tool (具) with a body (体), on target (的). Concrete, specific.
mnemonic.reading: GOOEY TIE TECHY (ぐたいてき): the techy's tie is concretely, specifically gooey.

examples.ja: もっと具体的に説明してください。
examples.en: Please explain more specifically.

items.note: Opposite: 抽象的 (ちゅうしょうてき), abstract. 具体例 = a concrete example.

mnemonic.meaning: Money (金) that melts (融) and circulates. Finance.
mnemonic.reading: KIN, YOU (きんゆう): your kin works in finance.

examples.ja: 兄は金融関係の会社で働いている。
examples.en: My older brother works at a finance company.

items.note: 金融機関 = financial institution. Same sound as 記入 (Level 20), filling in a form.

mnemonic.meaning: "YAH, YAH (やや)," a half-hearted yes. Only slightly convinced, somewhat.

examples.ja: 今日はやや寒い。
examples.en: It's slightly cold today.

items.note: A written, slightly formal 少し. Common in weather forecasts and news.

mnemonic.meaning: "MOTTO, MO' (もっとも)!" "More, more!" That's reasonable, natural... although, mind you, not too much.

examples.ja: 彼が怒るのももっともだ。
examples.en: It's only natural that he's angry.

examples.ja: 明日は休みだ。もっとも、宿題はあるけど。
examples.en: Tomorrow's a day off. Mind you, I do have homework.

items.note: Same sound as 最も (the most). もっともな理由 = a good reason. At the start of a sentence it adds a catch: 'although'.

mnemonic.meaning: 見 is see: you happen to see it.
mnemonic.reading: ME, CACKLE, RUE (みかける): you catch sight of me cackling.

examples.ja: 駅で先生を見かけた。
examples.en: I happened to see my teacher at the station.

items.note: Seeing by chance, not on purpose. Also written 見掛ける.

mnemonic.meaning: Shake (振) up interest (興). Promoting an industry.
mnemonic.reading: SHIN, COKE (しんこう): to promote Coke, they kick your shin.

examples.ja: 町は観光の振興に力を入れている。
examples.en: The town is working hard to promote tourism.

items.note: Used for industries, regions, sports. Same sound as 信仰 (Level 11, faith) and 新興 (Level 23, emerging).

mnemonic.meaning: The country's (国) meeting (会). Parliament, the Diet.
mnemonic.reading: COCK, KITE (こっかい): a rooster flies a kite in parliament.

examples.ja: 国会で新しい法律が成立した。
examples.en: A new law was passed in the Diet.

items.note: 国会議員 = member of the Diet. 国会議事堂 = the Diet building.

mnemonic.meaning: The car (車) stays (駐). Parking.
mnemonic.reading: CHEW, SHA (ちゅうしゃ): the Shah chews gum in the parking lot. Same sound as 注射 (injection).

examples.ja: ここに駐車しないでください。
examples.en: Please don't park here.

items.note: 駐車禁止 = no parking. Same sound as 注射 (injection). 駐車場 = car park.

mnemonic.meaning: Humbly say (申) and announce (告). A declaration.
mnemonic.reading: SHIN, COKE, COO (しんこく): you declare your Coke at customs. Same sound as 深刻 (serious).

examples.ja: 三月までに税金の申告をしなければならない。
examples.en: I have to file my tax return by March.

items.note: 確定申告 = annual tax return. Same sound as 深刻 (serious).

mnemonic.meaning: The one who knows (知) matters (事). The governor.
mnemonic.reading: CHEE, GEE (ちじ): "Cheese, gee!" says the governor.

examples.ja: 東京都の知事が記者会見を開いた。
examples.en: The governor of Tokyo held a press conference.

items.note: Each prefecture (県) has a 知事. A city has a 市長 (mayor).

mnemonic.meaning: Acid (酸) transforms (化) it. Oxidation.
mnemonic.reading: SUN, CAR (さんか): the sun oxidizes the car. Rust! Same sound as 参加 (participation).

examples.ja: りんごを切ると、すぐ酸化して茶色くなる。
examples.en: When you cut an apple, it oxidizes and turns brown quickly.

items.note: Same sound as 参加 (taking part). 酸化防止剤 = antioxidant.

mnemonic.meaning: 菌 has 艹 (plant): small plant-like things. A germ, fungus.
mnemonic.reading: KIN (きん): your kin have germs.

examples.ja: 手を洗って菌を落とそう。
examples.en: Let's wash our hands to get rid of germs.

items.note: Also as a suffix: 乳酸菌 (lactic bacteria), 大腸菌 (E. coli). 細菌 = bacteria (formal).

mnemonic.meaning: Supplement (補) and pay back (償). Compensation.
mnemonic.reading: HO, SHOW (ほしょう): "Ho!" the show pays you compensation. Same sound as 保証 (guarantee).

examples.ja: 事故の被害者に補償が支払われた。
examples.en: Compensation was paid to the victims of the accident.

items.note: Same sound as 保証 (guarantee) and 保障 (security). 補償 is money paid for damage.

mnemonic.meaning: The standard (典) mould (型). A typical example.
mnemonic.reading: TEN, CAKE (てんけい): ten cakes: a typical birthday.

examples.ja: これは日本の典型的な朝ご飯だ。
examples.en: This is a typical Japanese breakfast.

items.note: Mostly used as 典型的 (typical, classic).

mnemonic.meaning: Opposite (対) things illuminated (照). Contrast.
mnemonic.reading: TIE, SHOW (たいしょう): the tie shows the contrast. Same sound as 対象 (target).

examples.ja: 兄と弟は性格が対照的だ。
examples.en: The two brothers have contrasting personalities.

items.note: 対照的 = contrasting. Same sound as 対象 (target, subject).

mnemonic.meaning: Make (作) a tune (曲). Composing music.
mnemonic.reading: SACK, KYOKU (さっきょく): the composer writes a song about a sack.

examples.ja: この歌は彼が作曲した。
examples.en: He composed this song.

items.note: 作曲家 = composer. 作詞 (さくし) = writing lyrics.

mnemonic.meaning: Has (有) a machine (機)... of life. Organic.
mnemonic.reading: YOU, KEY (ゆうき): you hold the key to organic farming. Same sound as 勇気 (courage).

examples.ja: この店では有機野菜を売っている。
examples.en: This shop sells organic vegetables.

items.note: Same sound as 勇気 (courage). 有機栽培 = organic farming. Opposite: 無機 (inorganic).

mnemonic.meaning: The country's (国) register (籍). Nationality.
mnemonic.reading: COCK, SECK (こくせき): the rooster shows his nationality.

examples.ja: 彼は日本国籍を持っている。
examples.en: He has Japanese nationality.

items.note: 二重国籍 = dual nationality. Common on forms.

mnemonic.meaning: Foreign (胡) spicy seed (椒). Pepper.
mnemonic.reading: COKE SHOW (こしょう): pepper in your Coke at the show. Same sound as 故障 (breakdown).

examples.ja: 塩と胡椒で味をつける。
examples.en: Season with salt and pepper.

items.note: Usually written コショウ or こしょう. 塩胡椒 = salt and pepper. Same sound as 故障 (breakdown).

mnemonic.meaning: Stone (石) charcoal (炭). Coal.
mnemonic.reading: SECKY TAN (せきたん): you get a tan from the coal fire.

examples.ja: 昔は石炭で汽車を走らせていた。
examples.en: Long ago, steam trains ran on coal.

items.note: 炭 (すみ) on its own is charcoal.

mnemonic.meaning: The extent (程) of the lessons (課). A course of study.
mnemonic.reading: CAT, TAY (かてい): the cat takes a course. Same sound as 家庭 (home).

examples.ja: 大学院の修士課程に進んだ。
examples.en: I went on to a master's course at graduate school.

items.note: Same sound as 家庭 (household) and 過程 (process). 課程 is always about study.

mnemonic.meaning: The hot (熱) belt (帯) around the world. The tropics.
mnemonic.reading: NET TIE (ねったい): in the tropics you wear a net tie.

examples.ja: 熱帯の島で休暇を過ごした。
examples.en: I spent my holiday on a tropical island.

items.note: 熱帯夜 = a night that stays above 25°C. 熱帯魚 = tropical fish.
